legacy_cells.B: MedBayes-Lite: A Clinical Uncertainty Governance Layer for Risk-Aware Medical Decision Support
legacy_cells.C: Elias Hossain; Md Mehedi Hasan Nipu; Rajib Rana; Subash Neupane; Niloofar Yousefi
legacy_cells.I: 015_2025_MedBayes-Lite A Clinical Uncertainty Governance Layer for Risk-Aware Medical Decision Support.pdf
legacy_cells.S: Whether clinical QA predictions are sufficiently calibrated and safe to return, or should be deferred for human review.
legacy_cells.V: Accept a clinical QA answer or defer it for clinician review based on confidence.
legacy_cells.AJ: Transformer encoder models: BioBERT, Bio ClinicalBERT, PubMedBERT, and BERT-base; Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct in a sampling-only generative contrast.
legacy_cells.AK: BioBERT, Bio ClinicalBERT, PubMedBERT, and BERT-base (pretrained encoder backbones).
legacy_cells.CR: Expected calibration error (ECE) and Brier score were evaluated.
legacy_cells.FN: Reported results (source excerpt): On clinical multiple-choice question answering (MedMCQA and MedQA-USMLE), the layer reduces expected calibration error by 0.23 to 0.33 absolute and drivesharmfuloverconfident errors, those that are confident, incorrect, and clinically high-severity, toward zero (p≈0 ). The benefit is strongest under medical domain shift: when models trained on MedMCQA are evaluated on MedQA-USMLE, an uncalibrated baseline commits confident errors on about 21% of high-severity items, and the governance layer reduces this to near zero while roughly halving the calibration drift. We introduce and empirically evaluate the Clinical Uncertainty Score (CUS), a severity-weighted calibration metric that correlates strongly with harmful overconfidence (r≈0.88 ). The reported experiments evaluate the calibration and confidence-guided abstention components; the optional uncertainty-weighted attention pathway remained inactive (λ= 0 ).
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M7 Outcome & causal layer; M9 Safety & governance
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Keep severity-weighted calibration and confidence-guided abstention outside the base predictor; validate the combined gate under domain shift.
legacy_cells.FX: Title/abstract (PDF p. 1); introduction and related work (pp. 2–5); methods and framework (pp. 5–14, including Tables 2–7); results and relevant tables (pp. 15–21, Tables 8–16); discussion and limitations (pp. 21–26); conclusion, ethics/data statements, and supplementary sensitivity tables (pp. 26–33). | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text.
